status.truncated: Output hit the limit and was truncated
status.thinking_exhausted: The model used up its output budget while thinking
status.param_degraded: Some parameters were unsupported and adjusted

no_provider.title: No model connected yet
no_provider.detail: Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or any compatible service to get started.

no_default_model.title: No default model selected
no_default_model.detail: Choose a default model for {task} in Models & services.

no_vision_model.title: No model can read images yet
no_vision_model.detail: Screenshot OCR needs a model with image input. Pick one in Settings.

accessibility.title: Accessibility permission is needed to read selected text
accessibility.detail: Grant it to translate selections. Until then, you can type to translate.

screen_recording.title: Screen Recording permission is needed to capture
screen_recording.detail: Screen Recording takes effect after Wisp relaunches.

input_monitoring.title: Input Monitoring permission is needed
input_monitoring.detail: The floating button next to selected text, double-tap modifiers, and mouse buttons rely on it.

wayland_copy_first.title: Copy first, then translate
wayland_copy_first.detail: On Wayland, selected text can't be read directly.

capture_failed.title: Screenshot failed
capture_failed.detail: The screenshot didn't finish. Please try again.

elevated.title: Can't read text from an administrator window
elevated.detail: The target app runs as administrator, so Wisp can't read it. Copy the text and type to translate instead.

keychain_unavailable.title: System credential store is unavailable
keychain_unavailable.detail: Your API key is kept for this session only and must be re-entered after restart.

selection_unavailable.title: Can't read the selected text
selection_unavailable.detail: Copy it first, then translate it in input mode.

offline_model_missing.title: {model} isn’t downloaded yet
offline_model_missing.detail: This offline model isn’t on this device yet.

offline_model_downloading.title: {model} is downloading
offline_model_downloading.detail: It’s ready to use once the download finishes.

offline_task_unsupported.title: The offline model only translates
offline_task_unsupported.detail: Offline models can’t do “{task}”, and Wisp won’t switch to a cloud model for it on its own.

input_hint.accessibility: Grant Accessibility access to read selected text directly
input_hint.screen_recording: Grant Screen Recording access to take screenshots
input_hint.input_monitoring: Grant Input Monitoring access to use the extra triggers
input_hint.elevated: The app is running as administrator, so Wisp can't read its selection. Copy the text and paste it here
input_hint.wayland_copy_first: Wayland doesn't let Wisp read the selection. Copy the text first, then paste it here
input_hint.selection_unavailable: Wisp couldn't read the selected text. Copy it first, then paste it here

offline.missing_detail: This offline model isn’t on this device yet. Once it’s downloaded, this picks up automatically.
offline.auto_continue: Once it’s downloaded, this picks up automatically.
offline.failed: The download didn’t finish. You can retry.
offline.ready_retake: Capture again to recognize the text.
offline.missing_plain: This offline model isn’t on this device yet.
offline.downloading_retake: Once it’s downloaded, capture again to recognize the text.

fitness.cpu_only: No usable GPU, so it runs slowly on the CPU
fitness.integrated_gpu: Integrated graphics only, so it runs as slowly as on the CPU

fitness.memory_unknown: Could not read how much memory this device has
